title: Demand Signal
description: One unmet-software-demand signal produced by a sourcing pass. A signals file is a JSON array of 1 to 10 of these objects. Every source requires a verifiable URL, platform, brief quote, and real publication date. Engagement is optional for recent sources and required by the rubric when an older source needs proof of current activity.

landscape.description: Who else is already in this space and how each one differs. List every credible option you found, not just the closest one. A reader should be able to skim this and understand the field without running their own search. An empty list is only valid if landscape_summary says what you searched and why nothing came back.

does.description: Optional but strongly preferred. One neutral line on what this product actually is and does, written as if the maker wrote it. Keeps the list readable as a comparison instead of a list of dismissals.

difficulty.description: How hard this is to build. Free-form; common values: weekend_hack, weekend_project, real_project, venture_scale (or simply easy, medium, hard).

demand_strength.description: How strong the evidenced demand is. Free-form; common values: early, single_request, multiple_requests, trending, building, moderate, strong.
